pages.text: $(bold)Redstone Lamp$() — full bright when powered. $(italic)Macaw's Lights$() adds a $(bold)Redstone Lamp Slab$() for the half-height version. $(italic)Supplementaries'$() $(bold)Redstone Illuminator$() is a flush, decorative lamp that toggles with a signal.
pages.title: Switched Lights

pages.text: $(bold)Rainbow Lamp.$() Its colour follows the $(italic)strength$() of the redstone signal feeding it — 0 to 15 maps to the sixteen dye colours. A steady signal holds one colour; a $(l:6_reading/comparator)comparator$() or a changing input makes it a live readout in light.
pages.title: Rainbow Lamp
